title: Scalable synthesis of amorphous NiFe oxide hollow microspheres via glucose-mediated spray pyrolysis for industrial hydrogen production
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE01802A, Paper
Zixuan Guo, Fengyu Lai, Bowen Song, Shubo Wang, Harishchandra Singh, Parisa Talebi, Lin Zhu, Yuran Niu, Graham King, Yucheng Huang, Baoyou Geng
Amorphous NiFeOx hollow microspheres via Fe modulation, enabling industrial-scale oxygen evolution at ultralow overpotentials. Scalable synthesis bridges atomic design with electrolyzers, outperforming noble metals through hierarchical porosity.
